mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 13.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 90.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 2.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy regime that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a drop in housing starts signals a collapse in consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings visibility and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payroll growth signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances where both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters, combined with a decline in industrial production, indicates a deepening economic slowdown, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances where both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
